assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a new transparent game sprite for a deployed siege form. Reference image 1 defines the exact character identity and visual rendering style: preserve this olive-grey and orange tracked mortar vehicle, its low double-track chassis, heavy circular cannon joints, worn metal plates and orange ammunition canisters. Generate the SAME vehicle deployed into its stationary siege firing stance: four short articulated stabilizer outriggers visibly extended at the corners, two broad recoil spades grounded beside the tracks, the huge mortar barrel raised high, ammunition mechanism open and ready. It must look clearly like the original vehicle after deploying mechanical supports, not a different tank or a building. Keep the same elevated three-quarter camera and rightward cannon orientation. Full vehicle, entire barrel, and all stabilizer feet visible, centered with transparent margins, strong readable silhouette at 100 pixels. Match the detailed hand-painted 3D game finish, muted olive metal, orange bands and worn edges. Actual transparent background with crisp alpha, no ground, no backdrop, no smoke, no muzzle flash, no explosion, no text, no interface, no extra vehicle or person. This is one new form variant; do not produce a before-and-after sheet.
